# Factory Direct Homes Center

> Champion manufactured and modular homes with factory-direct pricing in Auburn, Indiana. Authorized dealer serving Indiana, Ohio, Michigan, Wisconsin, Illinois, and Kentucky.

## About

Factory Direct Homes Center LLC is a family-owned, authorized Champion Homes dealer located at 1211 State Road 8, Auburn, IN 46706. We offer new manufactured and modular homes with line-item pricing transparency — no hidden markups. Our showroom is about 20 miles from Champion's largest factory in Topeka, Indiana, giving us direct access to their full lineup (Aspire, Paramount, Redman, and Dutch series) with faster delivery and lower freight costs.

## Contact

- Phone: (260) 308-1457
- Email: sales@factorydirecthomescenter.com
- Address: 1211 State Road 8, Auburn, IN 46706
- Hours: Mon-Fri 9AM-5PM, Sat 10AM-4PM, Sun Closed

## Home Types

- Single Wide Homes: 500-1,200 sq ft, 1-3 bed, 1-2 bath
- Double Wide Homes: 1,000-2,400 sq ft, 2-4 bed, 2-3 bath
- Modular Homes: 1,000-2,500+ sq ft, 2-5 bed, 2+ bath, IRC code built on permanent foundations

All homes are new Champion-built and customizable, with manufacturer warranty. Contact us for current factory-direct pricing — we quote line by line so you see exactly what you pay for.

## How Buying Works

We sell the home factory-direct and arrange delivery. Site work, foundations, setup, and permits are handled by your own licensed contractors — most buyers save money this way, and we can share a referral list of licensed and insured contractors past customers have used.

## Service Area

Primary: Indiana (Auburn, Fort Wayne, Indianapolis, Noble County, DeKalb County)
Extended: Ohio (Toledo), Michigan (Kalamazoo), Wisconsin, Illinois, Kentucky

Delivery typically within 150 miles of Auburn, IN. Custom delivery quotes available for all locations.
